purpose: Compress one verified rehydration transition into the minimum causally sufficient context a successor agent must hydrate.

semantic_boundary.routing_successor: WHAT NEXT should be attempted; owned by ATHENA.REHYDRATION.SUCCESSOR.BATON.V1 when that extension is present
semantic_boundary.handoff_delta: WHAT STATE the successor must rehydrate before acting

source_of_truth: ATHENA.REHYDRATION.LOOP.V1 state, prompt and receipt hash chain
persistence_law: handoff delta is a deterministic projection and creates no Git commit

transition.optional_bound_context: completion.successor_baton is surfaced as routing_successor when present and remains bound indirectly by the completion receipt digest

hydration_modes.DELTA_ONLY: prompt and frontier content identities are unchanged; consume receipt/work/residual cone only
hydration_modes.PROMPT_CONE: prompt-stack identity changed; expand current prompt-policy cone plus work delta
hydration_modes.FRONTIER_CONE: frontier identity changed; expand current frontier cone plus work delta
hydration_modes.PROMPT_AND_FRONTIER_CONE: both content identities changed; expand both cones
hydration_modes.FULL_REHYDRATE_REQUIRED: required predecessor/current coordinate coverage is absent
hydration_modes.HEAD_MOVED_REHYDRATE_REQUIRED: handoff identity remains stable but observer is no longer at the exact loop checkpoint

identity_law.handoff_digest: SHA-256 identity inherited from the verified transition projection
identity_law.reason: freshness may invalidate consumption but cannot rewrite the identity of a completed predecessor transition

coverage.consequence: refresh frontier interpretation/witness before consequential scheduler action

optimization_goal: reduce handoff context cost while preserving verified causal continuity and fail-closed freshness
